notes.title: Austen Translation Musical Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30691731/e3c58a4fe8885af9ae44adcfd776720ba1da1e1f.png[/img]

Gentle People,

We hope you're all doing well out there and staying safe. 

We are delighted to announce that Austen Translation has received a musical upgrade. You may note that the dulcet tones of the rather frenetic accompanist sound a little different. Functionally, the music remains the same. But the previously utilized MIDI system has been replaced with a sampled piano. Keep an eye and an ear out for an update soon for a soundtrack release date. It's been a long-time coming but we're super busy here at W&M. 

Until the next announcement, enjoy this musical upgrade and as always, thanks so much for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30691731/f46a82b68c8aa5ebd5f549925ba3485f18f1dac7.png[/img]
